name: Silverstock Metals Inc.
summary: Silverstock Metals Inc. is a Canadian exploration company focused on identifying, acquiring, and advancing mineral properties, particularly those containing gold and silver. The company possesses an exclusive option to obtain complete ownership of the Gold Cutter Property, which consists of two adjoining mineral claims. This asset covers an area of approximately 1,821.1 hectares and is located within British Columbia's Kamloops Mining Division. Established in 2020, Silverstock Metals Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
